title: ESG Workflows Handbook
description:
Free, practical step-by-step workflows for CBAM, Scope 3, VSME and CSRD / ESRS, with worked examples on fictional companies, Excel and Word templates, browser tools and a Python package (esgcalc) that recomputes every number.

Self-reviewed by its author; not yet reviewed by an external practitioner. Not legal advice.

Website: mantas123456.github.io/esg-workflows-handbook. The handbook text is licensed CC BY 4.0; the code is licensed MIT.
